# Vendored client libraries

Pinned copies used by in-app PDF export (`/print-schema`, professional reports).

Kept same-origin so native WebView and Android hardening do not depend on cdnjs.

| File | Version | Upstream |
|------|---------|----------|
| `html2canvas.min.js` | 1.4.1 | https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas |
| `jspdf.umd.min.js` | 2.5.1 | https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF |
